system.description:
Range 60ft; wall 20ft wide, 10ft high, 10 minutes.

  • Creatures of Level 7 or lower within 20ft are Blinded 2d4 rounds on seeing it (no save).
  • A creature passing through meets each layer in order: Red 10d6 fire, Reflex halves; Orange 10d6 acid, Reflex halves; Yellow 10d6 lightning, Reflex halves; Green Fortitude or die (success 10d6 poison); Blue Fortitude or petrified; Indigo Will or Incapacitated 1 hour; Violet Will or banished to another plane.
  • A layer is removed only by Cone of Cold, Lightning Bolt, Magic Missile, Passwall, Disintegrate, Daylight or Dispel Magic respectively, in that order.

Classes: Illusionist, Druid
system.saveEffect: Half damage (red, orange, yellow layers); the other layers as listed
